versions.changelog:
Initial release of capability-radar — the first "evolution gear" for tracking skill and rule gaps.

- Adds a standardized memory format to log tool failures, repeated task patterns, rule conflicts, user corrections, and boundary workarounds.
- Clearly defines trigger conditions and required fields for capability-radar entries.
- Provides examples and a scanning protocol for Claude Cowork to prioritize follow-up actions.
- Lays out a feedback loop for evolving new skills and rule adjustments driven by real usage blockers.
